title: Kissed with Bitterness Ethiopian Cheese Dulet
description: A post-workout Ethiopian dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese, rich flavor, and a satisfying crunch. Made with love and bitterness in mind.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, about 2 minutes.
Add cumin powder and red pepper flakes, cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add shredded beetroot and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add caramelized onion and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally.
Add shredded Mexican cheese and cook for 1-2 minutes, until melted and creamy.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a ceramic tagine and serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately, while the cheese is still slightly melted and the flavors are still combined.
